node.statement: Now w has source C^m, a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, and target the stated finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra A; it is linear as part of being an extended inclusion. Applying lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone with delta=c0*epsilon and delta_prime=t_3, using the preceding local inequalities, makes w an extended t_3-inclusion. The adjective non-unital merely means no unit-preservation premise is imposed. The separately assumed estimate forwards as ||w(I_{C^m})-I_A||<=c0*epsilon<=t_3, and changing only the allowed defect bound leaves the same one-dimensional images P_j.
